sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior instruction: do not make independentOperationLimits and escortedOperationLimits universally mandatory when iceOperationApplicable is true. The current bare sh:or permits either branch without evidence that the selected limitation matches the ship's operating mode, so it can pass with the wrong alternative and cannot represent cases where both options are appropriate. Add a canonical operation-mode/escort-status selector or relationship and condition each limitation on that evidence; locate the missing canonical term via the matcher. Keep the supplied ship target, canonical terms, datatypes, and applicability condition.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional branch so it does not make both independentOperationLimits and escortedOperationLimits universally mandatory whenever iceOperationApplicable is true. The source requires operating-mode-specific limitations and says both options should be specified where appropriate; encode the applicable alternative or conditional evidence without turning those alternatives into an unconditional conjunction. Preserve the supplied ship target, canonical terms, datatypes, and applicability condition.

Preserve the prior instruction: do not make independentOperationLimits and escortedOperationLimits universally mandatory when iceOperationApplicable is true. The current bare sh:or permits either branch without evidence that the selected limitation matches the ship's operating mode, so it can pass with the wrong alternative and cannot represent cases where both options are appropriate. Add a canonical operation-mode/escort-status selector or relationship and condition each limitation on that evidence; locate the missing canonical term via the matcher. Keep the supplied ship target, canonical terms, datatypes, and applicability condition.
